source.film: KODAK PROFESSIONAL PRO IMAGE 100 Color Negative Film

notes: The film's launch datasheet; Kodak has published no later one. Kodak's own servers no
longer carry it; the URL is an archive (found for issue #31).
Characteristic curves: daylight exposure, Status M densitometry, Process C-41. The
exposure axis is labelled in Kodak's bar notation (3-bar.0 = -3.0). The sheet gives no
Log H ref: -0.84 is assumed, where Kodak's ISO 100 sheets put a grey card (log10(0.8 /
100) + 1.26), as Ektar 100's and Gold 100's do. It puts a grey card at the red density
the sheet's exposure check gives (1.03 to 1.23).
Spectral sensitivity: effective exposure 1/50 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min.
Spectral dye density: typical densities of a midscale neutral subject and D-min.
Page coordinates: the plots' axes are calibrated from their tick marks and gridlines.
